import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
rng=random.Random(11)
N=64
rib=[]
# 2000 windows over a 64-cycle, max counts -> huge Z, 64 core links
while len(rib)<2000:
    s=rng.randrange(N); L=20
    p=[((s+k)%N)+1 for k in range(L)]
    rib.append({'path':p,'count':1000000})
order=[]
for s in range(N):
    a=(s%N)+1; b=((s+1)%N)+1
    order.append([min(a,b),max(a,b)])
queries=[]
for i in range(512):
    s=rng.randrange(N)
    p=[((s+k)%N)+1 for k in range(64)]
    a=rng.randint(0,1000000); b=rng.randint(a,1000000)
    queries.append({'id':'q%03d'%i,'path':p,'threshold':[a,b]})
data={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':order,'queries':queries}
raw=json.dumps(data).encode()
print("bytes",len(raw),"records",len(rib),"sumlen",sum(len(r['path']) for r in rib))
open('/workspace/tmp/big2.json','wb').write(raw)
t0=time.perf_counter()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True)
t1=time.perf_counter()
out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print("time %.2f rc %d"%(t1-t0,p.returncode))
if 'links' in out:
    print("core",sum(1 for l in out['links'] if l['round']==0),"links",len(out['links']))
    print(out['queries'][0])
else: print(out, p.stderr.decode()[:500])
EOF
